Theme

Body, health & movement

stink verb

also stinky, smelly, it stinks, smell bad

classical

Plaut. As. 5.2.44: an fētet anima uxōrī tuae? (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 385: foeteō

fēteō, fētēre

verb, second conjugation

stink, smell bad

Lewis & Short writes fēteō, “less correctly foeteō”, the spelling Traupman uses.

Other words

  • fētidus, fētida, fētidum — stinking, stinky

    classical · Cic. Pis. 13: ōre fētidō (Lewis & Short); Traupman 385: foetidus

  • male olēre — smell bad

    also used · classical · Traupman 381

See also smell, yucky.

SourcesLewis & Short: feteo

Lewis & Short: fetidus
